comparison_plan.question: Does increasing packet budget alone improve delivery, queue drops and latency?
comparison_plan.grain: queue setting x network condition x trial
comparison_plan.population: 32 paced TCP flows,500 UDP echoes,8 HTTP per gate;3 repeats per cell;2 queue budgets x2 network conditions
comparison_plan.unit: median of3 trial-specific UDP p95 RTT values in milliseconds, not a pooled p95
comparison_plan.derivation: nearest-rank p95 within each trial then median of three p95 values
comparison_plan.delivery: grouped categorical bars plus compact four-cell table
comparison_plan.reason: matched workload; unordered network conditions; preserve any reversal and min/max ranges
comparison_plan.finding: Full three-trial ranges retained for every queue x condition cell; do not choose a queue from a single best trial.

comparison_plan.question: Does mixed traffic stay intact through a three-minute window, idle and resumed load?
comparison_plan.population: one180second offered UDP window plus4x32MiB TCP,36 spaced HTTP probes,20second idle and resumed mixed load
comparison_plan.unit: exact verified bytes/replies, process RSS KiB
comparison_plan.reason: short finite stability evidence, not hours-long soak or proof of no memory leak

methods.path: Iran to Sofia mother-local capsules, same quotas as prior checkpoint
methods.queue: Both endpoints configured64 then256 total queue_packets; split-UDP gives TCP packet limits32 vs128, observed from stats. queue_bytes remains262144 total,131072 per lane; no other tuning knob changed. No default promoted.
methods.workload: 32x256KiB TCP at0.5Mbps per flow,500x1000byte UDP echoes at125pps,8HTTP per matched gate
methods.order: queue64: baseline,combined,combined,baseline,baseline,combined; queue256 opposite sequence. Not randomized or simultaneous; time/order and unseeded netem variation remain confounders
methods.impairment: combined40±20ms delay and1% random loss independently per direction, actual IFB packet/drop deltas checked on Iran tap0 and Sofia forwarded loopback ingress; capsule-stack rather than physical WAN emulator
methods.stats: per-gate before/after cumulative deltas with2.2second settling for stats snapshots; control/settling may contribute; no attribution to a specific connection
methods.limits: Three trials per cell, only8HTTP per gate, no statistical significance claim. Paced generator, not capacity benchmark or independent users. Complete UDP delivery over reliable WSS/TCP does not imply raw UDP loss immunity.
methods.soak: A three-minute mixed window only; not hours-long soak. RSS snapshots alone cannot rule out leaks.

validation_notes: 15 unique group x gate rows, no discarded primary trials
UDP fields intentionally null in idle gate; TCP bytes0 represents no bulk TCP fixture, not failed delivery
All fixture SHA256 hashes and raw nearest-rank quantiles recomputed; independent raw cross-foot validates headline
Packet and byte drops kept separate; effect attributed only to this bounded experiment
